theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_psd_radial_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (d m : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), f 0 = 0 → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => f r / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ σ : Euclid d, f (Real.sqrt (ρ ^ 2 - ‖σ‖ ^ 2))) / (unitBallVolume (d + m) * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (d + m)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ)
